name: Windsurf
paste_label: Paste this into Windsurf's Cascade chat
steps_title: Cascade sets it up for you.

register.p: Then register it in Windsurf's MCP config: ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json, or on newer builds ~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json (Windows: %APPDATA%\devin\mcp_config.json). Use whichever exists; if neither, ask the user to open Cascade → MCPs → Configure, which creates it. Merge this into the file, keeping every server already there. Create the file if it doesn't exist. If a {{SERVER}} entry already exists, ask the user before replacing it.

confirm.p: Ask the user to open Cascade → MCPs and press refresh. {{SERVER}} should show its tools.
